versions.changelog:
**Now creates a separate workspace folder for imported agents instead of overwriting the main workspace.**

- Extracts AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, and optional openclaw.json patch from pasted markdown.
- Creates a new workspace-<agent> folder for the files, preserving the current main workspace.
- Avoids overwriting any existing workspaces by generating unique folder names when needed.
- openclaw.json patches only apply within the new workspace, and only if explicitly requested.
- Reports only short results and new paths after completion.

Initial release — enables agent file extraction and update in an OpenClaw workspace from pasted markdown.

- Extracts AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, and optionally an openclaw.json patch from custom-GPT-style markdown.
- Writes the extracted files to the current OpenClaw workspace, replacing existing versions.
- openclaw.json patching is only done when explicitly requested, and only as a minimal, non-overwriting edit.
- Validates section completeness and only applies when all three main files are present and complete.
- Provides clear and concise status updates, including missing file prompts when inputs are incomplete.
